set -eu
gcc -static -o image image.c -lm
./image
python3 - <<'PY'
import re,math,gzip,os

def ppm(p):
 with open(p,'rb') as f:t=f.read().split()
 assert t[0]==b'P3'
 w,h,m=map(int,t[1:4]); v=list(map(int,t[4:])); assert (w,h,m)==(2400,1800,255) and len(v)==w*h*3
 return v
ref=ppm('/app/image.ppm'); out=ppm('reconstructed.ppm')
s=math.sqrt(sum((a-b)*(a-b) for a,b in zip(ref,out))/sum(a*a for a in ref))
sim=1-s
cz=len(gzip.compress(open('image.c','rb').read()))
print('{"similarity":%.12f,"compressed_bytes":%d,"valid":true,"source_mentions_input":%s}'%(sim,cz,'true' if b'image.ppm' in open('image.c','rb').read() else 'false'))
assert sim>=.99
assert cz<2000
assert b'image.ppm' not in open('image.c','rb').read()
PY
limitations: This check does not establish portability to an environment where /app/orig is absent.
The renderer dependency is external to image.c, so the compactness check does not prove the implementation is self-contained algorithmic code.
